nina_marketing: Quick ask for launch collateral: need validated benchmark numbers + reproducible artifacts for three headline claims (gen p95, embed p95, cost/1k tokens). Can runtime run a smoke today and full sweep next week?

sam_runtime: Yes. Clarify: exact model tags, payload pack, smoke sample size, and acceptance tolerances? Also cold-starts or steady-state?

nina_marketing: Models: redwood-alpha-7b:fp16 (2026-03-01) and redwood-alpha-7b:quant8 (2026-03-05). Payload: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/payloads/launch-pack-v5.json. Smoke: 30 samples each. Full: gen 8k, long-complete 1k, embeds 5k. Include cold-start p95 (first after 5m idle) + steady-state p50/p90/p95, cost calc, and CPU/GPU heatmaps. Artifacts: aggregated CSV, percentile PNGs, 50 annotated traces, run config + seed. Drop to s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-1901234000/ with embargo. Tolerances: suggest p95 headline +/-10% and cost delta <=15% for comms sign-off.

sam_runtime: Agreed. We'll run smoke with seed=20260327 for determinism, provide per-request CSV (request_id,model,seq_in,seq_out,tokens,latency_ms,gpu_pct,mem_mb,trace_url) and the perf CLI command used. Smoke ETA ~1h. If smoke within tolerances we'll schedule full sweep Tue 02:00-06:00 low-traffic window. Need ops approval for burst nodes if you want faster.

raul_ops: I'll create the S3 folder and set embargo ACL to 2026-04-05, add watchers: marketing & platform-metrics.

perf-bot: queued bench-1901234000-smoke (est 1h).

perf-bot: bench-1901234000-smoke completed. Summary uploaded: s3://redwood-internal/marketing/bench-1901234000/smoke/summary.csv. Preliminary numbers: fp16 gen p95=175ms, quant8 gen p95=194ms (+11%), embed p95 (batch8)=27ms, estimated cost delta quant8 ~12% lower. Raw traces: s3://.../traces/.

nina_marketing: Nice. Please draft one-line summaries and a short embargoed paragraph for the press kit; legal will review. Also include the exact perf command and a recommended public phrasing with tolerances.

sam_runtime: Draft one-liners (prelim): redwood-alpha-7b:fp16  p95 gen 175ms (steady-state). redwood-alpha-7b:quant8  p95 gen 194ms (+11%), cost ~12% lower on this payload. embeddings (batch8) p95 27ms. Embargoed blurb: "Internal benchmark on representative launch payload shows quantized variant reduces per-token compute cost with measured tail latency tradeoffs; see appendix for methodology and raw traces." We'll polish after full sweep.

anya_legal: Approve wording with small edits (use "measured" not "modest"). Please add methodology link in the appendix.

sam_runtime: Will proceed to schedule full sweep pending ops burst approval. Will tag job bench-1901234000-full and post artifacts when done.

nina_marketing: Thanks all  ping #marketing when full sweep is queued and again when artifacts are live.

perf-bot: tag:complete :white_check_mark:
